textos.txt: Welcome to the desert... here, time is cruel to everything that is not well stored
Humidity? Zero. Heat? Maximum. Result? A degraded sample if you hesitate
So all this heat is like a stability test?
Perfectly said. To store is to protect. And here you must master this requirement or your data will evaporate
Prepare yourself. The fine sand hides great traps
Which of the alternatives represents a **nonconformity** with item 7.4 of ISO/IEC 17025?

alternativas.txt: The laboratory keeps test items in cabinets with temperature control and protection from direct sunlight.
Storage conditions are recorded and monitored to preserve the characteristics of the samples.
Calibration and test items are temporarily stored in a common area, with free access to visitors.
Documented procedures define the proper handling and storage of received items.
The laboratory stores samples in labeled containers, with expiration dates and clear identification.
